name: How does green building improve occupant health?

mainEntity.name: How does green building improve occupant health?

acceptedAnswer.text: Better daylighting, ventilation, thermal comfort, non-toxic materials, and biophilic design reduce sick building syndrome, improve sleep, and boost productivity and well-being.
